lessonTitle: 41. Mutual position of a line and a plane
lessonTitleEnglish: Mutual position of a line and a plane
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Lines and planes in space
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 10 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: A line can lie in a plane (infinitely many common points), meet it (one point) or be parallel to it (no common points).
stages.headlineEnglish: A line can lie in a plane (infinitely many common points), meet it (one point) or be parallel to it (no common points).

stages.headline: Test: a line not in a plane that is parallel to some line of the plane is parallel to the plane.
stages.headlineEnglish: Test: a line not in a plane that is parallel to some line of the plane is parallel to the plane.

stages.headline: In the cube A₁B₁ ∥ (ABC) because A₁B₁ ∥ AB and AB lies in (ABC).
